title: mixcore core API v0.3: shared definitions

version.description: Contract version. v0 is unstable until the first tagged release.

kind.description: muteGroup and dca are v0.1 (x32: mute groups 1..6, DCA groups 1..8; xair, v0.2: mute groups 1..4, DCA groups 1..4). Their only field is mute. headamp is v0.3: a microphone preamp, numbered as the console numbers it (xair: /headamp/01..16, XA-F73); its only field is gain. Which channel a headamp feeds is not modelled yet (xair.md section 3.4: insrc is unverified), so a UI names it 'Preamp N'.

index.description: Required for input, muteGroup and dca (1-based). Omitted for main.

field.description: v0.1: muteGroups and dcas are the strip's group membership (read-only); effectiveMute is derived by the core and appears only in state messages, never in commands. For a muteGroup strip, mute true means the group is engaged (muting its members); for a dca strip, mute true means the DCA is muted. v0.2: a strip without a membership on its console has no such field: on xair the main strip belongs to no mute group and no DCA (docs/protocols/xair.md section 3.2), so a set or read of main muteGroups is ERR_UNSUPPORTED and state messages omit it. v0.3: gain is the dB gain of a headamp strip (CR-23).

level.description: A level in dB. JSON has no infinity, so fully off is the string "-inf". NaN never appears.

value.description: fader and gain (v0.3): level; mute: boolean (true = muted, or for a muteGroup: engaged); name: string; muteGroups/dcas (v0.1): groupList; effectiveMute (v0.1): effectiveMute object. The field decides the type.

groupList.description: v0.1: group numbers in ascending order, e.g. [2, 5].

effectiveMute.description: v0.1 (design CR-01, SR-04): whether the strip is silenced toward Main LR, and why. muted = own OR any listed group. muteGroups lists the engaged mute groups the strip belongs to; dcas lists the muted DCAs it belongs to (x32: a muted DCA silences its members toward Main LR only, unless the console preference says otherwise; per-bus effective mute comes with buses; xair: the same rule, XA section 3; its main strip has no membership, so its effective mute is its own mute). UI text: 'MUTED by MG 2', 'DCA 1 muted'.
